_doc: Lane manifest — single source of truth for which data asset is CANONICAL per role, and which are PARKED (retired/superseded but kept on disk). Born 2026-07-18 after one session found five built-but-unwired assets, all traceable to loaders whose hardcoded defaults predated the English-only pivot (2026-07-17). Loaders should migrate to reading this file; until then scripts/audit_wiring.py flags code that references a parked lane. Editing rule: moving a lane between canonical and parked is an operator-visible change — record the reason and date.
